name: mcp-pdf
description: Merge, split, extract, rotate, reorder and stamp PDF files from chat: mark an invoice PAID, pull pages out of a scan, join a set of documents into one. Everything stays on your machine.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: pdf_info
tools.description: Page count, page sizes in points and millimetres, paper name, metadata (title, author, producer, dates) and whether the file is encrypted. Read-only: the file is never modified. Free tier: unlimited.

tools.name: pdf_count
tools.description: Page count per file plus the total, for any number of PDFs. Read-only. A file that cannot be read is reported per file; the others still count. Free tier: unlimited.

tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Join several PDFs into one, in the order given. Page sizes are kept as they are - a merged file may have mixed page sizes, and the answer says so. Inputs are never modified. Free tier: up to 5 files per merge.

tools.name: pdf_split
tools.description: Write one new PDF per range. Ranges are 1-based and may be open-ended: "1-3,5,7-" gives pages 1-3, page 5, and page 7 to the end. The input is never modified. Free tier: files up to 30 pages.

tools.name: pdf_pages
tools.description: Pull selected pages out into one new PDF, in the order written: "2,4-6" gives four pages. Asking for a page twice copies it twice. The input is never modified. Free tier: files up to 30 pages.

tools.name: pdf_rotate
tools.description: Turn pages by a multiple of 90 degrees, clockwise for a positive number. The rotation is added to whatever the page already had, which is what a sideways scan needs. Writes a new file; the input is never modified. Free tier: files up to 30 pages.

tools.name: pdf_stamp
tools.description: Draw a word such as PAID or DRAFT across the pages, in a colour and position you choose. Writes a new file; the input is never modified. Free tier: the PAID and DRAFT presets in their preset colours.

tools.name: pdf_watermark_business
tools.description: Put your own business name and VAT id in the footer of every page, from the shared business profile that mcp-invoice and mcp-docx write. Use it before sending a document out. Pro.

tools.name: pdf_reorder
tools.description: Write a new PDF with the pages in the order you give. The order must name every page exactly once, so nothing is dropped by accident - use pdf_pages when you do want a subset. Pro.

tools.name: pdf_text
tools.description: Best-effort text extraction: the page content streams are decompressed and the text-showing operators are read. It works on PDFs written with standard fonts (exports from word processors, invoices, reports). It returns nothing for a scan - there is no OCR - and glyph indices instead of letters when a font ships a custom encoding, and it says which case you are in. Read-only. Free tier: unlimited.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
